summary: Foley police and sheriff's deputies arrested seven people, ages 13 to 19, on charges including attempted kidnapping after a Sunday-morning incident on Highway 59, NBC 15 reported, and an Elberta man held on a state terrorist-threat charge now faces a federal threat charge, FOX10 reported. The jail roster could not be re-read Monday evening; the bookings below are from the early-Monday read.

entries.title: Attempted kidnapping arrests: seven people, ages 13 to 19, in Foley
body: Foley police, working with the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office, arrested seven people after an incident at about 3:50 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, in the 8000 block of Highway 59, NBC 15 reported Monday. Police said those involved range in age from 13 to 19 and that they would not release more information because of the ages of the suspects and the victims, according to the station. Police said they did not believe there was a threat to the public and called it an ongoing investigation.

The charges reported were attempted first-degree kidnapping — trying to abduct someone to harm, terrorize or hold them; burglary — unlawfully entering a building to commit a crime; certain persons forbidden to possess a firearm; and menacing — putting someone in fear of serious injury. The report did not say which charges each person faces. No matching booking was on the county jail roster when it was read early Monday.

entries.title: Federal threat charge: Gorden Ellis Wade
body: Gorden Ellis Wade of Elberta, arrested by Baldwin County sheriff's deputies Nov. 6 on a state charge of making a terrorist threat in the first degree, now also faces a federal charge of making threats in interstate communications, FOX10 reported Monday. According to the station, the federal complaint was filed Nov. 10, Wade was arrested on it Nov. 12 and is being held in the Escambia County, Alabama, jail, and he waived a preliminary hearing.

An FBI affidavit cited by FOX10 says Facebook posts made around Nov. 6 threatened to shoot and bomb private schools and to kill police officers, firefighters, religious leaders and other first responders. Deputies found a loaded handgun in his waistband and an AK-47-style rifle with a round chambered in his truck during a traffic stop near U.S. 98 and Virginia Road, the station reported, citing the affidavit, which says he acknowledged the account was his and admitted making the posts. His attorney told FOX10 he had no comment.
He was released from the Baldwin County jail Nov. 7 on a $7,500 bond, according to FOX10 and the jail roster. A federal complaint is an accusation, not a conviction.

entries.title: Investigation: Foley police and deputies at County Road 12 home
body: Foley police officers and Baldwin County sheriff's deputies responded to a home on County Road 12 at about 10 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, WKRG reported. An officer at the scene called it an ongoing investigation and said there was no threat to the public, according to the station.

WKRG reported that at least one person appeared to be in custody and that a dark sedan was towed from the property. Neither agency had released details, and it was not clear whether anyone was arrested or charged. No matching booking was on the jail roster when it was read early Monday.

Blue RAM Media reported Monday that officers first responded to a possible domestic incident or disturbance at the home and during the investigation found indications that a person may have been held against their will. Neither agency had released further information, according to that report.

entries.title: Child-endangerment arrest: Nelia Patricia Irias-Sarmiento
body: Nelia Patricia Irias-Sarmiento, 23, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.

She was booked on three counts of endangering the welfare of a child — failing to protect a child from harm — and one count of interfering with a domestic-violence emergency call, which means stopping someone from calling for help. She was in custody when the roster was read early Monday.

entries.title: Eluding and DUI arrest, Daphne: Kendrix Romarius Shepard
body: Kendrix Romarius Shepard, 54, was arrested by Daphne police at 12:21 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, in the 20000 block of Canterbury Road, according to the city's arrest log and the jail roster. No police statement or news report was found.

He was booked on charges of attempting to elude police — fleeing an officer who signaled a stop — driving under the influence of alcohol, second-degree marijuana possession, possessing drug paraphernalia and resisting arrest. The roster shows him released Nov. 15.

entries.title: Family harassment arrest: Dylan Taylor Morrison
body: Dylan Taylor Morrison, 30, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 2 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.
He was booked on two counts of harassing a family member — harassment directed at a family or household member. He was in custody when the roster was read early Monday.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 14–16: Nestor Saul Hernandez-Huertas, Kiwianna Kiora Mona McPherson, Kolby Derek Brock, Joe Louis Pritchett Jr, Harvey Albert Sidener IV, Alvin Lavon Sanders, Mario Jermaine Carter
body: The sheriff's office arrested Nestor Saul Hernandez-Huertas, 31, at 1:40 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol, and Harvey Albert Sidener IV, 39, at 3:30 p.m. Saturday on a third-degree criminal trespass charge — entering or staying on property unlawfully. Gulf Shores police arrested Kiwianna Kiora Mona McPherson, 23, just before midnight Saturday as a fugitive from justice — wanted in another state. Bay Minette police arrested Alvin Lavon Sanders, 56, at 12:15 p.m. Sunday on five failure-to-appear, comply or pay charges. All four were in custody when the roster was read early Monday.

Foley police arrested Joe Louis Pritchett Jr, 59, at 4:19 p.m. Saturday on charges of possessing dangerous drugs and public intoxication, and the sheriff's office arrested Kolby Derek Brock, 23, at 11:46 a.m. Sunday on a disorderly conduct charge; the roster shows both released Nov. 15. Early Monday, the sheriff's office arrested Mario Jermaine Carter, 40, at 2:20 a.m. on a public intoxication charge; he was in custody when the roster was read. All information is from the jail roster.
